dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Everyone's just... sitting here, playing cards all day? Hmm... If we could, we should get up every so often and exercise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You're leaving? Oh right, I need to get back too. Got a whole lot of people waiting for me at the tribe. It's leg day today, and no one's escaping those reps.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You know, warming up before a card game actually helps your mind move faster. So, wanna run a few laps with me?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Gah, I lost... Strange, why am I feeling so dizzy? It's like my brain's slowed down... Maybe I overloaded my barbells during training today...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Cards? Sure, I just finished my training for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Victory! Whew... I was so nervous back there. Think my heart was beating faster than it does during training.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: *sigh* One wrong move is all it takes, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm taking a break right now, so I'm game for a game! Relax, even though it was arms day today, picking up a couple of cards should be no biggie.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I won! I get dragged off by the folks in my tribe to play cards every day. Guess that finally paid off.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It's my loss. Wow, you sure are good at this game! Guess I'd better practice more if I wanna give you a real challenge next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
